title: kell + Infinitive: What You Must Do

sections.title: From "X is needed" to "you must do X"
sections.content: You know *kell* with an infinitive from A1. Here it comes with verbs that have a prefix. *kell* never changes for person: Be *kell* *csekkolni* ("[One] must check in") stays the same no matter who has to do it. Who is doing it is understood from context.

sections.title: kell + infinitive
rows: you have to show your passport
you have to fill out a form

items.english: At the airport, you have to check in.

items.spanish: A kapunál meg kell mutatni az útlevelet.
items.english: At the gate, you have to show your passport.

sections.content: A prefix (*be-*, *meg-*, *ki-*) goes in front of *kell* and the rest of the verb follows it: be *kell* csekkolni, meg *kell* mutatni. (*Becsekkolni kell* is also possible, but it stresses the action.)
